opportunities.title: 1 of 3 major voice assistants understand this language
opportunities.detail: One assistant already works in this language, so speech recognition, a voice and language understanding have been shown to be feasible.
opportunities.why: About 124 million Indonesian speakers are online today, and that should reach 148 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (5,038 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).
